message:
Now I understand the full flow. Let me trace through the vulnerability:

1. Root CBOR item is a map
2. It has a `PAYLOAD` tag (6) whose value is a map
3. The payload map has a `FILE` tag (17) whose value is a map
4. The file map has a `HASH` tag (7) whose value is an array
5. The first element of the hash array is itself an array (to trigger `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash_array`)
6. One of the elements of that inner array is NOT an array (e.g., an integer)
7. `fu_coswid_firmware_parse_hash` is called on that non-array element
8. `cbor_array_get(item, 0)` is called on a non-array item, causing a heap-buffer-overflow READ

Now I need to understand the uSWID header format. Let me look at the fuzzer and the header parsing:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd && grep -n "uswid" -A 50 contrib/ci/oss-fuzz.py | head -80</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
